Where is Belarus?
Belarus is a country in Eastern Europe.
It is between Russia, Ukraine, Poland, Lithuania and Latvia.
The capital city of Belarus is Minsk.
Minsk is the biggest city in the country.

Many people live and work in Minsk.
It is a modern city with tall buildings, museums and parks.
The city is also known for its clean streets
and organized public transport.
Belarus has a cold climate.
The winters are long and snowy.
The summers are warm, but not very hot.
Many people wear warm clothes in winter
because it can be very cold.
In some parts of Belarus,
the temperature in winter can go below
by just 20 degrees Celsius.
People enjoy winter activities like ice skating and skiing.
In summer, the weather is pleasant
and people spend time outside
having picnics and enjoying nature.

What is Belarus famous for?
Belarus is famous for its beautiful nature.
There are many forests, rivers and lakes.
About 40% of Belarus is covered by forests.
One famous forest is Biauija Forest.
It is home to the European bison, a big and strong animal.
This forest is one of the last
and largest remaining parts of the primeval forest
that once covered much of Europe.
Many people visit this forest to see the bison
and enjoy the fresh air.
Belarus is also famous for its castles and old buildings.
There are many beautiful castles like Mir Castle
and Nesvish Castle.
Many tourists visit these places.
Mir Castle is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
It has red brick walls and looks like a fairytale castle.
Nesvish Castle is another famous place
with a beautiful park and a lake around it.
Belarus is also known for its rich history.
Many historical sites show the country's past.

The breast fortress is a famous historical site.
It played an important role in World War II.
Today it is a memorial where people can learn
about the history of Belarus.
Food in Belarus.
The food in Belarus is simple but delicious.
People eat a lot of potatoes, meat and bread.
One popular dish is draniki.
Draniki are potato pancakes.
People eat them with sour cream.
Another popular dish is borscht.
Borscht is a soup made with beets.
It is red and very tasty.
People in Belarus also eat many dairy products
like cheese and yogurt.
Cottage cheese called forg is very popular.
People eat it with honey or jam.
Belarusian cuisine also includes hearty meat dishes.
Machanka is a famous dish made with pork,
onions and sour cream.
It is often eaten with pancakes or bread.
Another traditional dish is koduni,
which are stuffed potato pancakes filled with meat.
People in Belarus also drink a lot of tea.
In the winter, they like to drink hot tea to stay warm.
They also enjoy herbal teas made with dried flowers
and berries.
Kvas is another traditional drink.
It is a fermented drink made from bread
and it has a slightly sweet taste.
People in Belarus are friendly and polite.
They speak Belarusian and Russian.
Many people also learn English.
The Belarusian language has many unique words and expressions.

Some people speak both Belarusian and Russian
in their daily life.
Every year Belarus has festivals with music and dancing.
One famous festival is kupala night.
People make big fires, sing songs and celebrate summer.
Another popular festival is Masla Nica,
a holiday that marks the end of winter.
People eat pancakes, dance and have fun.
Belarus has a strong tradition of folk music and dance.
People wear traditional clothes and play old musical instruments
like the the type of bagpipe and goosely, a string instrument.
Many young people still enjoy traditional dances during festivals.
Nature and animals.
Belarus has many national parks.
These parks protect animals and nature.
The European bison is a special animal in Belarus.
It is big and strong.
People come to Belarus to see this animal in the wild.
Other animals in Belarus include wolves,
foxes and many kinds of birds.
Belarus also has many rivers and lakes.
In summer, people like to swim and go fishing.
The largest lake in Belarus is Lake Narak.
It is a popular place for vacations.
People go there to relax, swim and enjoy the fresh air.
In winter, some lakes freeze and people can walk on the ice.
Ice fishing is also a popular activity in Belarus.
Conclusion Belarus is a beautiful country with forests,
castles and delicious food.
It has friendly people and interesting traditions.
It is a country with a rich history and a love for nature.
Would you like to visit Belarus one day?
I hope you learned something new today.
